name: Camera sensors
description: Turns an area of a camera into a sensor: you teach the states (door open or closed, light on or off) and Nuxiva recognises them by itself, with no external services and no images leaving your home.
capabilities: Any area of the image, with states taught from real examples
Continuous reading confirmed over several readings to avoid false changes
Rejects scenes it has never seen instead of guessing
Quality index: accuracy and similarity between states
Events in the camera log and on the bus, for automations and alerts
